name: Paizuri de Level Drain
original_name: パイズリでレベルドレイン
source:
You're a hero who got stuck in a trap.
A girl is about to use her breasts to drain you of your levels, your semen and your pride!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/RJ329106.html]DLSite[/url]]

一个女孩要用她的乳房来榨干你的水平、你的精液和你的骄傲！
